name: Sina
h1: Connect the work behind AI-powered media
lede: Across the Sina group, Weibo is putting AI at the centre of its products and advertising. Airtable gives product, operations and commercial teams one connected way to run that work.
why_h2: AI is reshaping the group's advertising and products
why_p: Recent results from Weibo, Sina's listed subsidiary, show AI moving into ad creative and product development while competition for ad budgets stays intense.

signals.title: AI now drives half of feed ad creative
signals.body: Weibo's Q2 2026 results reported that AI-generated creative accounted for 50 percent of promoted-feed real-time-bidding ad spend in June.
signals.angle: Track AI creative pipelines, approvals and client campaigns in one shared system.

signals.title: Q1 2026 advertising revenue up 9 percent
signals.body: Weibo's advertising and marketing revenue reached US$369.8 million in Q1 2026, with 562 million monthly active users in March.
signals.angle: Give commercial and product teams one view of advertiser programmes and launches.

signals.title: FY2025 results and US$150 million dividend
signals.body: Weibo reported FY2025 revenue of about US$1.76 billion and approved an annual cash dividend of about US$150 million.
signals.angle: Steady revenue with margin pressure rewards operations that run on connected data, not manual reporting.
